operating_notes.text: Forest clearance for the Bhadrasahi Iron & Manganese Mining Lease is valid up to 30.09.2030, co-terminus with the extended mining lease period.
The Supreme Court dismissed OMDC's SLPs against Jai Balaji Industries on 08.05.2026, upholding the Calcutta High Court Division Bench order of 09.12.2025 in FMA 939/2012 and FMA 941/2012.

timeline.summary: 29-Apr-2026: Odisha's Forest, Environment & Climate Change Department extended OMDC's Bhadrasahi iron & manganese forest clearance to 30.09.2030, co-terminus with the extended mining lease.

14-May-2026: The Supreme Court dismissed OMDC's two SLPs (Diary Nos. 73842/2025 and 73816/2025) against Jai Balaji Industries by common order dated 08.05.2026, leaving the Calcutta High Court order of 09.12.2025 in FMA 939/2012 and FMA 941/2012 in force.
Eastern Investments disclosed promoter shareholding of 50.1% with nil encumbrance in OMDC as of March 31, 2026.
